identity: A WU tempo deck in which tapping your own creatures is the engine, the removal trigger, and the clock at once. Station is a cost that taps a creature WITHOUT using that creature's {T} symbol, so summoning-sick bodies qualify - it is a free, repeatable, sorcery-speed tap button. Every tap fires Mechan Navigator (loot), Nanoform Sentinel (untap another permanent, worth exactly one extra Station per turn), Starfighter Pilot (surveil 1) and banks charge counters. The same tapping arms this pool's tapped-matters removal: Cryoshatter destroys the creature it enchants the moment that creature becomes tapped. The honest problem with the plan is that the fliers it produces are 2/2s, so the damage clock is slow; Virulent Silencer fixes that by converting each connection into two poison counters, and 10 poison arrives in three connects where 20 damage needs five. Tezzeret, Cruel Captain supplies a free untap every turn with no once-per-turn cap. Divert Disaster is the only stack interaction available to any build in this series.

mainboard.name: Synthesizer Labship
mainboard.oracle_text:
Station (Tap another creature you control: Put charge counters equal to its power on this Spacecraft. Station only as a sorcery. It's an artifact creature at 9+.)
2+ | At the beginning of combat on your turn, up to one other target artifact you control becomes an artifact creature with base power and toughness 2/2 and gains flying until end of turn.
9+ | Flying, vigilance
mainboard.role: Threat/Payoff — 1-mana Spacecraft; 2+ animates an artifact into a 2/2 flier every combat

mainboard.name: Cryoshatter
mainboard.oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature gets -5/-0.
When enchanted creature becomes tapped or is dealt damage, destroy it.
mainboard.role: Interaction — 1-mana Pacifism that upgrades to a kill when the creature taps; 2 of 24 cards force that on demand

mainboard.name: Reroute Systems
mainboard.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Target artifact or creature gains indestructible until end of turn. (Damage and effects that say "destroy" don't destroy it.)
• Reroute Systems deals 2 damage to target tapped creature.
mainboard.role: Interaction — the deck's REAL protection: indestructible at instant speed on a below-threshold Spacecraft

mainboard.name: Hardlight Containment
mainboard.oracle_text:
Enchant artifact you control
When this Aura enters, exile target creature an opponent controls until this Aura leaves the battlefield.
Enchanted permanent has ward {1}.
mainboard.role: Interaction — 1-mana exile; 13 of 24 artifact hosts, though killing the host returns the creature

mainboard.name: Mechan Navigator
mainboard.oracle_text: Whenever this creature becomes tapped, draw a card, then discard a card.
mainboard.role: Engine — loots whenever it becomes tapped, i.e. on every Station

mainboard.name: Starfighter Pilot
mainboard.oracle_text: Whenever this creature becomes tapped, surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.)
mainboard.role: Engine — surveils whenever it becomes tapped

mainboard.name: Sunstar Chaplain
mainboard.oracle_text:
At the beginning of your end step, if you control two or more tapped creatures, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
{2}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control: Tap target artifact or creature.
mainboard.role: Engine — the deck's only +1/+1 counter source, and an instant-speed tap outlet for Cryoshatter

mainboard.name: Lumen-Class Frigate
mainboard.oracle_text:
Station (Tap another creature you control: Put charge counters equal to its power on this Spacecraft. Station only as a sorcery. It's an artifact creature at 12+.)
2+ | Other creatures you control get +1/+1.
12+ | Flying, lifelink
mainboard.role: Threat/Payoff — 2+ anthem takes both fliers to 3/3; NOT a blocker, it is not a creature until 12+

mainboard.name: Wurmwall Sweeper
mainboard.oracle_text:
When this Spacecraft enters, surveil 2.
Station (Tap another creature you control: Put charge counters equal to its power on this Spacecraft. Station only as a sorcery. It's an artifact creature at 4+.)
4+ | Flying
mainboard.role: Threat/Payoff — the realistic clock: 4+ makes it a 2/2 flier; ETB surveil 2

mainboard.name: Mechan Shieldmate
mainboard.oracle_text:
Defender
As long as an artifact entered the battlefield under your control this turn, this creature can attack as though it didn't have defender.
mainboard.role: Engine — 3 power for two mana is the best Station battery in blue; a 3/2 defender that actually blocks

mainboard.name: Mental Modulation
mainboard.oracle_text:
This spell costs {1} less to cast during your turn.
Tap target artifact or creature.
Draw a card.
mainboard.role: Interaction — {U} on our turn: taps a creature (ours or theirs) AND draws a card

mainboard.name: Divert Disaster
mainboard.oracle_text: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {2}. If they do, you create a Lander token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.")
mainboard.role: Interaction — the stack answer; if they pay the {2}, we get a Lander

mainboard.name: Nanoform Sentinel
mainboard.oracle_text: Whenever this creature becomes tapped, untap another target permanent. This ability triggers only once each turn.
mainboard.role: Engine — 3-power artifact creature; untaps a body that already Stationed, buying exactly +1 Station per turn

mainboard.name: Virulent Silencer
mainboard.oracle_text: Whenever a nontoken artifact creature you control deals combat damage to a player, that player gets two poison counters. (A player with ten or more poison counters loses the game.)
mainboard.role: Threat/Payoff — 2 poison per connecting nontoken artifact creature; 10 poison beats 20 damage on this clock

mainboard.name: Tezzeret, Cruel Captain
mainboard.oracle_text:
Whenever an artifact you control enters, put a loyalty counter on Tezzeret.
0: Untap target artifact or creature. If it's an artifact creature, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
−3: Search your library for an artifact card with mana value 1 or less, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
−7: You get an emblem with "At the beginning of combat on your turn, put three +1/+1 counters on target artifact you control. If it's not a creature, it becomes a 0/0 Robot artifact creature."
mainboard.role: Engine — a FREE untap every turn with no once-per-turn cap, and a second +1/+1 counter source

mainboard.name: Idyllic Beachfront
mainboard.oracle_text:
({T}: Add {W} or {U}.)
This land enters tapped.
mainboard.role: Land — the only WU dual in the pool (enters tapped)

mainboard.name: Command Bridge
mainboard.oracle_text:
This land enters tapped.
When this land enters, sacrifice it unless you tap an untapped permanent you control.
{T}: Add one mana of any color.
mainboard.role: Land — any colour; its 'tap an untapped permanent' clause is a COST here, not upside

mainboard.name: Secluded Starforge
mainboard.oracle_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{2}, {T}, Tap X untapped artifacts you control: Target creature gets +X/+0 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
{5}, {T}: Create a 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token.
mainboard.role: Land — enters untapped; taps X artifacts as a repeatable multi-trigger outlet

mainboard.role: Land

mainboard.role: Land

sideboard.name: Annul
sideboard.oracle_text: Counter target artifact or enchantment spell.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs the 74-card artifact class and the 16-card enchantment class; 1 mana to hard-counter either

sideboard.name: Banishing Light
sideboard.oracle_text: When this enchantment enters, exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs resolved enchantments and bombs that beat the soft counter

sideboard.name: Emergency Eject
sideboard.oracle_text: Destroy target nonland permanent. Its controller creates a Lander token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.")
sideboard.when_to_board: instant-speed answer to any nonland permanent, including fliers

sideboard.name: Desculpting Blast
sideboard.oracle_text: Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand. If it was attacking, create a 1/1 colorless Drone artifact creature token with flying and "This token can block only creatures with flying."
sideboard.when_to_board: vs a single large threat; makes a flying blocker if it was attacking

sideboard.name: Focus Fire
sideboard.oracle_text: Focus Fire deals X damage to target attacking or blocking creature, where X is 2 plus the number of creatures and/or Spacecraft you control.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs fast aggro; X is 2 plus 15 creatures/Spacecraft in this list, so routinely 4-7 for one mana

sideboard.name: Chrome Companion
sideboard.oracle_text:
Whenever this creature becomes tapped, you gain 1 life.
{2}, {T}: Put target card from a graveyard on the bottom of its owner's library.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs the 31-card graveyard class; repeatable, and a becomes-tapped body

sideboard.name: Radiant Strike
sideboard.oracle_text: Destroy target artifact or tapped creature. You gain 3 life.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs artifact decks; also kills a tapped creature

identity_es: Un mazo de tempo WU en el que girar tus propias criaturas es a la vez el motor, el disparo de eliminación y el reloj. Station es un coste que gira una criatura SIN usar el símbolo de {T} de esa criatura, así que los cuerpos con mareo de invocación cumplen: es un botón de girar gratuito, repetible y a velocidad de conjuro. Cada giro dispara a Mechan Navigator (descartar y robar), Nanoform Sentinel (desgirar otro permanente, que vale exactamente un Station extra por turno), Starfighter Pilot (surveil 1) y guarda contadores de carga. Ese mismo girar arma la eliminación del pool que se fija en criaturas giradas: Cryoshatter destruye la criatura que encanta en el momento en que esa criatura se gira. El problema honesto del plan es que los voladores que produce son 2/2, así que el reloj de daño es lento; Virulent Silencer lo arregla convirtiendo cada conexión en dos contadores de veneno, y 10 de veneno llegan en tres conexiones donde 20 de daño necesita cinco. Tezzeret, Cruel Captain aporta un desgiro gratuito cada turno sin límite por turno. Divert Disaster es la única interacción en la pila disponible para cualquier construcción de esta serie.
